parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

ECS_FILE: Backs up files from ECS instances.

OSS: Backs up OSS buckets.

NAS: Backs up NAS file systems.

OTS: Backs up Tablestore instances.

UDM_ECS: Backs up an entire ECS instance.

SYNC: Performs data synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型，取值范围：

ECS_FILE：备份ECS文件
OSS：备份阿里云OSS
NAS：备份阿里云NAS
OTS：备份阿里云OTS
UDM_ECS：备份ECS整机
SYNC：数据同步
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the backup plan. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length. The name must be unique for each data source type within a backup repository
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划名称。1~64个字符，单个备份仓库下每一种数据源类型的备份计划名称唯一
parameters.name: plan_name

parameters.help_en: The backup type. Set the value to COMPLETE, which specifies a full backup
parameters.help_zh: 备份类型。取值为COMPLETE，表示全量备份
parameters.name: backup_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup repository
parameters.help_zh: 备份仓库ID
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup policy. The format is `I|{startTime}|{interval}`. This specifies that a backup job runs at an interval of `{interval}`, starting from `{startTime}`. Overdue backup jobs are not retried. If the previous backup job is not complete, the next backup job is not triggered. For example, `I|1631685600|P1D` indicates that a backup job runs daily starting from 14:00:00 on September 15, 2021.

startTime: The start time for the backup, specified as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

interval: The backup interval, specified in the ISO 8601 duration format. For example, `PT1H` represents one hour and `P1D` represents one day
parameters.help_zh:
备份策略。可选格式：`I|{startTime}|{interval}`。表示从`{startTime}`开始每隔`{interval}`的时间执行一次备份任务。不会补偿已过去时间的备份任务。如果上一次备份任务没有完成，不会触发下一次备份任务。例如`I|1631685600|P1D`表示从2021-09-15 14:00:00开始每隔一天备份一次。

startTime：备份起始时间，UNIX时间，单位秒。
interval： ISO8601时间间隔。例如：PT1H表示间隔一小时。P1D表示间隔一天
parameters.name: schedule

parameters.help_en: The backup retention period, in days. The minimum value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 备份保留天数，最小值为1，单位为天
parameters.name: retention

parameters.help_en: The ID of the client group that runs the data synchronization job. This parameter is required only if `SourceType` is set to `SYNC`
parameters.help_zh: 执行数据同步计划的客户端组ID。（仅同步需要）
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system. This parameter is required only if SourceType is set to NAS
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为NAS时，需要配置该参数。表示文件系统ID
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en: The time when the file system was created, specified as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter is required only if SourceType is set to NAS
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为NAS时，需要配置该参数。表示文件系统创建时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒
parameters.name: create_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket. This parameter is required only if SourceType is set to OSS
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为OSS时，需要配置该参数。表示OSS bucket名称
parameters.name: bucket

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the objects to back up. If specified, only objects with this prefix are backed up. This parameter is required only if SourceType is set to OSS
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为OSS时，需要配置该参数。表示备份前缀。指定后，仅备份前缀相匹配的对象
parameters.name: prefix

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS instance. This parameter is required only if SourceType is set to ECS_FILE
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示ECS实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The details of an entire instance backup, specified as a JSON string.

`snapshotGroup`: Specifies whether to use a snapshot-consistent group. This feature is available only if all disks of the instance are ESSDs.

`appConsistent`: Specifies whether to enable application consistency. This must be used with the `preScriptPath` and `postScriptPath` parameters.

`preScriptPath`: The path to the pre-freeze script.

`postScriptPath`: The path to the post-thaw script
parameters.help_zh:
整机备份详情，类型为JSON字符串。

snapshotGroup：是否使用一致性快照组（仅实例所有云盘均为ESSD时有效）。
appConsistent：是否使用应用一致性（需要搭配参数preScriptPath和postScriptPath使用）。
preScriptPath：冻结脚本路径。
postScriptPath：解冻脚本路径
parameters.name: detail

parameters.help_en: The region where the ECS instance is located
parameters.help_zh: 整机备份实例所在地域
parameters.name: udm_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The traffic shaping policy for the backup. Format: `{start}:{end}:{bandwidth}`. You can specify multiple rules separated by vertical bars (`|`). The specified time ranges cannot overlap. This parameter is required only if SourceType is set to ECS_FILE.

start: The start hour.

end: The end hour.

bandwidth: The bandwidth limit, in KB/s
parameters.help_zh:
仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示备份流量控制。格式为`{start}:{end}:{bandwidth}`。多个流量控制配置使用|分隔，并且配置时间不允许有重叠。

start：起始小时。
end：结束小时。
bandwidth：限制速率，单位KB/s
parameters.name: speed_limit

parameters.help_en: The paths of the files and directories to include in the backup. The path can be up to 255 characters in length. This parameter is required only if SourceType is set to ECS_FILE
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示需要备份的路径，该路径下所有文件都备份。最多支持255个字符
parameters.name: include

parameters.help_en: The paths of the files and directories to exclude from the backup. The path can be up to 255 characters in length. This parameter is required only if SourceType is set to ECS_FILE
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示不需要进行备份的路径，该路径下所有文件都不备份。最多支持255个字符
parameters.name: exclude

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use Windows Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) to ensure data consistency. This parameter is required only if SourceType is set to ECS_FILE.

This feature is available only for Windows ECS instances.

If data in the backup source changes during the backup, set this parameter to `{"UseVSS":true}` to ensure data consistency.

If you enable VSS, you cannot back up multiple file directories at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示是否使用Windows系统VSS定义备份路径。

此功能仅支持Windows类型ECS实例。
如果备份源中有数据更改，需要确保备份数据与源数据的一致时，才可配置为`["UseVSS":true]`。
选择使用VSS后，不支持多个文件目录同时备份
parameters.name: options

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source data source. This parameter is required only if `SourceType` is set to `SYNC`
parameters.help_zh: 源端数据源ID。（仅同步需要）
parameters.name: data_source_id

parameters.help_en: The backup paths
parameters.help_zh: 备份路径
parameters.name: path

fields.help_en: The retention period of the geo-redundant backup, in days
fields.name: destination_retention

fields.help_en:
The backup policy. The format is `I|{startTime}|{interval}`. This specifies that a backup job runs at an interval of `{interval}`, starting from `{startTime}`. Overdue backup jobs are not retried. If the previous backup job is not complete, the next backup job is not triggered. For example, `I|1631685600|P1D` indicates that a backup job runs daily starting from 14:00:00 on September 15, 2021.

In the format, startTime is the backup start time (a UNIX timestamp in seconds), and interval is the backup interval (in ISO 8601 duration format). For example, PT1H represents one hour and P1D represents one day
fields.help_zh:
备份策略。可选格式：I|{startTime}|{interval}。表示从{startTime}开始每隔{interval}的时间执行一次备份任务。不会执行已过去时间的备份任务。如果上一次备份任务没有完成，不会触发下一次备份任务。例如I|1631685600|P1D表示从2021-09-15 14:00:00开始每隔一天备份一次。

startTime：备份起始时间，UNIX时间，单位为秒。
interval： ISO8601时间间隔。例如：PT1H表示间隔一小时。P1D表示间隔一天
fields.name: schedule

fields.help_en: The retention period of the backup, in days
fields.name: retention

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to disable the rule
fields.name: disabled

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable geo-redundancy for the backup
fields.name: do_copy

fields.help_en: The ID of the destination region for geo-redundancy
fields.name: destination_region_id

parameters.help_en: The backup rules
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划规则
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en: The name of the Tablestore instance
parameters.help_zh: 表格存储实例名称
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The details of the Tablestore instance
parameters.help_zh: 表格存储实例详情
parameters.name: ots_detail

parameters.help_en:
The type of cross-account backup. Valid values:

`SELF_ACCOUNT`: Backs up data within the same account.

`CROSS_ACCOUNT`: Backs up data to a different account
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source Alibaba Cloud account for a cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号ID
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role that is created in the source account
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to permanently retain the latest backup snapshots.

`0`: Do not retain.

`1`: Retain
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启保留至少一个备份版本。
0 - 不保留
1 - 保留
parameters.name: keep_latest_snapshots

parameters.help_en: The type of the destination data source. This parameter is required only if `SourceType` is set to `SYNC`
parameters.help_zh: 目的端数据源类型。（仅同步需要）
parameters.name: dest_source_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination data source. This parameter is required only if `SourceType` is set to `SYNC`
parameters.help_zh: 目的端数据源ID。（仅同步需要）
parameters.name: dest_data_source_id

parameters.help_en: The details of the destination data source. This parameter is required only if `SourceType` is set to `SYNC`
parameters.help_zh: 目的端数据源详情。（仅同步需要）
parameters.name: dest_data_source_detail

parameters.help_en: The changelist configuration for incremental file synchronization. This parameter is required only if `SourceType` is set to `SYNC`
parameters.help_zh: 增量文件同步列表的配置。（仅同步需要）
parameters.name: change_list_path

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to disable the backup plan upon creation
parameters.help_zh: 计划是否默认禁用
parameters.name: disabled

parameters.help_en: The edition of the backup plan. Valid values are `BASIC` and `STANDARD`. Default value: `STANDARD`
parameters.help_zh: 版本类型，支持BASIC和STANDARD，默认值为STANDARD
parameters.name: edition
